propositions: Release 0.13.0 version bumps (pyproject.toml, server.json, uv.lock, CHANGELOG.md) were prepared, tested locally, and merged to main via Gerrit change 2385 with all preflight gates green.

Manual MCP Registry fallback (mcp-publisher publish) blocked by navapbc GitHub OAuth-App org-access policy restriction requiring org admin intervention.
Release is incomplete and closed without resolution; MCP Registry, attestation verification, Homebrew tap, and channel-install probe acceptance criteria remain unmet.
